bundle.//targets: nsis, not "all". "all" also builds the WiX/MSI target, which fails on this machine: light.exe aborts ICE validation with LGHT0217 / Windows Installer error 2738 (the VBScript runtime cannot be reached by the ICE custom actions). The generated .wxs itself is fine -- it only emits warnings -- so this is an environment fault, not a packaging defect. NSIS does not use WiX or ICE at all, and is the better fit here anyway: a smaller per-user install that needs no admin.
